title: feat(range): support new routing system
body:
This updates `range` lifecycle methods to support the new routing system.

## `getWidgetState` changes

This method ignores previous UI state values. Otherwise, new values gets skipped.

## `getWidgetSearchParameters` changes

This method is self-contained. It sets both `disjunctiveFacets` and `numericRefinements`. It doesn't overwrite other `numericRefinements` but only sets the one coming from `widgetParams.attribute` to an empty object.

---

_`getConfiguration` will be removed later to not break everything._
